 GTA VI’s download will need up to 212GB of hard drive space
 Rockstar says to make sure you have ‘ample space’ on your device.

 is a news writer who covers the streaming wars, consumer tech, crypto, social media, and much more. Previously, she was a writer and editor at MUO. You’re going to need a lot of extra storage space on your console if you’re planning to play Grand Theft Auto VI later this month. Rockstar Games confirmed on Tuesday that the pre-load file will require up to 212GB “depending on your device.”
 Rockstar says you can start pre-loading the game on the PlayStation 5 on Tuesday, November 10th at midnight in your local time zone, while users on Xbox Series X | S devices can start pre-loading on November 10th at 12AM GMT. The company says to “make sure you’ve got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible.” Rockstar also posted a support page with more information about pre-loading the game.

 We might not have to wait 13 years for the next GTA 
 The announcement lines up with recent rumors suggesting that the game could take up a significant amount of storage space. GTA VI launches on November 19th for $79.99 and is only available via digital download . Physical versions of the game will include just a code in the box.
